ccs-install/welcome.title: Start Here: Build Your AI Cold Email System
ccs-install/welcome.content:
# Start Here: Build Your AI Cold Email System

CCS Install walks you through building a cold-email system to get new clients for your agency.

You’ll set up AI to research buyers, help build your offer, prepare lead lists, write emails and help manage replies. You’ll also prepare the sales materials you need when someone books a call.

**You provide the facts about your business, check the work and take the sales calls. The AI handles the research, writing and repeatable tasks we teach it.**

## What You Will Build

### 1. Your Offer And Target Client

The AI researches possible buyers and helps write your offer: who you help, what you deliver, what you charge and when you get paid.

You check that the offer matches what your agency can deliver.

### 2. Your Sales Materials

You’ll prepare your sales call script, proposal and follow-up emails, plus your website and VSL where needed.

The lessons give you instructions, examples and templates. The AI helps turn those into materials for your business.

### 3. Your First Checked Lead List

The AI helps find businesses, research their websites and check them against the client types you want to reach.

You review a sample before using the full list.

### 4. Your First Email Campaign

The AI drafts your outreach emails and follow-up. You check the message, approve it and follow the setup instructions to put the emails and leads into your sending tool.

You’ll check the campaign before switching it on.

### 5. Your AI Inbox Manager

You’ll teach the AI how to research people who reply, draft answers, prepare follow-ups and help arrange sales calls using your calendar.

You’ll set clear rules for what it can do and what needs your approval.

### 6. Your Daily And Weekly Checks

You’ll have a clear way to check replies, booked calls, campaign problems and how many unused leads remain.

You’ll know what to review each day and when to refill the list or change an email.

## What You Need To Do

Your job is to:

- Explain what your agency sells and can deliver.
- Supply genuine results, examples and existing sales materials.
- Sign in to the tools you own when the instructions ask.
- Review the AI’s work and approve the offer, leads, emails and spending.
- Take the sales calls and deliver the service you sell.

For example, if you run an SEO agency, you can use this cold-email system to find SEO clients. You continue delivering SEO to those clients.

## How To Use The Three CCS Sections

**CCS Install: Build The System**  
Follow these steps in order. Each page tells you what to do, what to give the AI and what the finished result should look like.

**CCS Resources: Get Help With A Specific Step**  
Open the linked lesson when you need help with your offer, emails, website, VSL or sales process. Complete that task, then return to Install.

**CCS Training: Run The Working System**  
Once the setup has been checked and demonstrated, use Training to manage replies, refill leads, review results and fix problems.

**Start with Install. You can open the other lessons when you need them.**

## Your First Task: Get Grok Bot Ready

Grok Bot is the AI app we’ll use for the tasks in this setup.

**Already have Grok Bot installed and working? Skip to [“Your Next Step”](#your-next-step) below.**

### 1. Download Grok Bot

Open the [Grok Bot download page](https://x.ai/bot), download the app for your computer and install it.

### 2. Open The App And Sign In

Click **Sign in** and complete the sign-in steps in your browser.

Grok Bot currently uses a Cursor account for sign-in. Follow the prompts to use your existing account or create one. If you already pay for Grok or Cursor, check whether your subscription includes access before buying another plan. [Official setup instructions](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/get-started).

### 3. Choose A Plan If You Need One

For the initial setup, we recommend starting with **Premium, currently $30 per month before tax**. It includes Grok Bot. This gives you access to begin setup; your usage will determine whether you later need a higher plan. [View the current plans](https://x.ai/pricing).

### 4. Check That You Can Use It

Finish the introduction in the app. Open the first Bot chat, type **“Hello”** and check that it replies.

You’re ready to continue when you can open Grok Bot and receive a reply.

## Your Next Step

**Add The CCS Instructions To Grok Bot**

The next page will show you which CCS files to download, how to give them to Grok Bot and how to check that it can read them. Those instructions teach it the CCS methods it will use for your business.

ccs-install/get-instantly.title: Get Instantly + Your Inboxes
ccs-install/get-instantly.content:
# Get Instantly + Your Inboxes

Instantly is the tool your cold email actually sends from. Everyone needs this set up, whether we're running it for you or you're running it yourself.

---

## 1. Create Your Instantly Account

Sign up at [instantly.ai](https://instantly.ai) and pick a plan that covers the number of inboxes you'll be sending from.

---

## 2. Buy Your Domains

Buy your sending domains from [Porkbun](https://porkbun.com). Use **lookalike domains** — variations of your main business domain, not your actual website domain. This protects your primary domain's reputation.

💡 **Tip:** Can't come up with lookalike domains? Paste your primary domain into Claude or ChatGPT and ask it to generate lookalike domain ideas.

---

## 3. Set Up Your Inboxes

We have an exclusive partnership with Scaled Mail for Closing Clients System members.

👉 **Use this link to get started:** [ccs.scaledmail.com](https://ccs.scaledmail.com)  
**Discount code:** CSS10 (10% off)

Scaled Mail handles the full inbox setup and warm-up for you — you don't need to touch DNS records or configure warming manually. Just give them your Instantly account details and they connect everything directly.

---

## If We're Running This For You

⚠️ **Add us as an admin on your Instantly account** so our team can build and run your campaigns. Go to Instantly → Settings → Team, invite **matt@avaero.io** and **seanlongden@icloud.com**, and set the role to Admin.

That's it on your end for this step — once we're in, we handle the rest of the tech setup.

ccs-install/get-ai-ark.title: Get AI Ark
ccs-install/get-ai-ark.content:
# Get AI Ark

AI Ark is what we use to build lead lists — it finds companies that match your ICP and verifies their emails automatically.

---

## Sign Up

Create an account at [ai-ark.com](https://ai-ark.com).

---

## Why AI Ark

- **Built-in email verification** — every export is verified in real time, including catch-all addresses.
- **Personal lead database** — the first export of a lead costs 1 credit, re-exporting the same lead later only costs 0.1 credits. Meaningful savings if you're cycling through the same contacts every few months.

---

## If We're Running This For You

Just get the account set up and add us as a collaborator — our team handles list building, scoring, and cleaning from there. You don't need Lead Formatter or anything else, that's on us.

## If You're Running This Yourself

Head to **List Building** in CCS Training for the full walkthrough on building and scoring lists, including how we use Lead Formatter and Claude to clean and qualify leads before they go into a sequence.
